row.notes: Renamed from Game_SettingsVM_ResolveSettingByNameHash: the input is an entry/category name (e.g. "cat_driver_icons") and the result is used as a string value, not a setting. Computes the djb2 hash (5381, x33) of the NeStr *name, maps about 35 known hashes to constant key strings (default 0x145638190), then returns func_0x1441e5bd0(*(*(sys+0x8e0)+8), NeStr(*(sys+0x8e8)), NeStr(key)) with sys=*(self+0x620). Callers (Game_SettingsEditScreenViewModel_WorkoutEntriesAction with "cat_driver_icons", 0x141da6270 and 0x141da92d0 with the name from an entry's node, both settings row builders) write the result with Vm_NodeSet_String into the entry's string node +0x198, mostly when DAT_14606c9dc == 1. Hook point to remap per-category strings. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
